external_flrw_q0_age_at_mean_z20_s.label: EXTERNAL_CONVENTION_OUTSIDE_LOCKED_DOMAIN
external_flrw_q0_age_at_mean_z20_s.definition: int dln a / H_FLRW from a=1e-12 to a_ref=1/21, H_FLRW^2 = H0^2 (Om a^-3 + Or a^-4 + OL), q=0, with the lock's rounded H0, Om, Or, OL
external_flrw_q0_age_at_mean_z20_s.applies_to: all five cases identically (no shear term)
external_flrw_q0_age_at_mean_z20_s.not_a_model_output: the locked background is defined only on [a_ref, a_end]; SCENARIO_LOCK sets clock.absolute_cosmic_age_s = null; no q-dependent extrapolated age is reported

evidence.background.scope: Stress-free prescribed EoR background conditional on data at zbar20. This family is not an observationally admitted primordial Bianchi cosmology. No continuation to recombination or today is claimed.

independent_blockers.consequence: the locked scenario admits no model content below zbar=4; relaxing the native validator alone would not make a z<4 run part of the locked scenario

independent_blockers.blocker: DriverConfig::validate requires 4 <= end_zbar < 20; DriverConfig::read and Driver::new call it
AxbiSource::at_redshift accepts only zbar in [4,20], and the lock defines no z<4 source model
independent_blockers.lock_source_high_z_support: The analytic function is selected as an explicit phenomenological continuation over 8<zbar<=20. It is not claimed to be measured or calibrated there; model uncertainty is separate from numerical convergence. No tabulated provider is extrapolated.
independent_blockers.note: the guard bounds an analytic emissivity law (SFRD x ionizing yield x f_esc), not a missing table; lifting it needs a newly admitted z<4 source model

derived_or_non_blocking.reason: a_end = 1/(1+end_zbar) is computed in Driver::new from the validated config

derived_or_non_blocking.lock_clock_origin: elapsed proper time since each matched zbar=20 initial slice
derived_or_non_blocking.reason: the native clock is elapsed proper time since zbar=20; a continuation needs no absolute age

derived_or_non_blocking.item: H and s are not checkpoint fields
derived_or_non_blocking.reason: the frozen background recomputes them from a and q_ref (see restart_inventory.expansion)

claim_classes.numerical_reproducibility: cases.*.replay: bitwise restart determinism of the frozen solver over the stated window only (cases.*.replay.window)
conditional_prediction: cases.*.restart_inventory state values (x_HII, x_HeII, x_HeIII, T, photon stock)
claim_classes.physical_attribution: NONE: q_ref differences are conditional responses of a prescribed background family; SCENARIO_LOCK scientific_admission = NOT_ISSUED_PENDING_IMPLEMENTATION_RUNS_AND_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW

review_corrections.change: Removed the per-case cosmic_age_at_mean_z20_s_from_locked_background and cosmic_age_at_restart_s fields and the a=1e-12..a_ref quadrature of the sheared H law that produced them (outside the locked domain; SCENARIO_LOCK clock.absolute_cosmic_age_s=null). Added one top-level q=0 FLRW age at zbar=20, labelled EXTERNAL_CONVENTION_OUTSIDE_LOCKED_DOMAIN and identical for all cases. No q-dependent extrapolated age is reported. The z<4 foreground H model is now labelled as an extension beyond a_end (sensitivity only).

Provenance is described as RECEIPT_LINKED_PLUS_CONTENT_BOUND for the four composed cases and GIT_MANIFEST_HASH_BOUND_PLUS_CONTENT_BOUND for SHEAR_PLUS. COMPOSITION_RECEIPT.json, composed RETURN.txt and composed checkpoint.txt are hashed into input_sha256. chain_ok now also requires equality of every RETURN counter/clock/error field with the checkpoint and of both RETURN residuals with the natively recomputed residuals. The git refs whose tips actually contain each checkpoint sha256 are found by a scan of the rei_bianchi object store run now, and the REI_COMMIT ancestry is recorded.

The dt-form versus dN-form agreement is reported as a clock/H consistency check (dt/dN=1/H) plus a quadrature-error estimate (native rows versus Richardson and versus a cubic spline). It is stated not to validate tau(4..20), because both forms share n_e, sigma_T and H.

Renamed ne_vs_native_eos_cm3, ne_vs_history_last_row_cm3 and abundance_rows_charge_neutrality_cm3 to electron_formula_*_consistency fields, and stated that charge neutrality is imposed by the EOS (n_e = n_H x_HII + n_He (x_HeII + 2 x_HeIII)); these are bookkeeping identities, not tests.

The z<4 list is now a top-level z_below_4_continuation with three independent blockers (1 scenario-lock scope, 2 DriverConfig::validate 4<=end_zbar<20, 3 source redshift guard plus no admitted z<4 source model), each with the source line found now in both compiled epochs, and with background domain, absolute age and stored H/s marked DERIVED or NON_BLOCKING. Each case records the positive control from the cached native replay: the config.cfg end_zbar passed DriverConfig::read and Driver::new (both call validate).

Each case states the replay window next to the residual: accepted-step count, zbar range, rejections in window, attempts per step and the per-step dln a regime (constant step, endpoint-clipped final step). The headline residual covers every compared field including ledgers, photons and the energy residual. The reject and step-size-change branches are listed as not exercised. No new native window run.

BUILD.json and the result record the script sha256, htt_base HEAD and dirty flag, script git tracking status, python/numpy/scipy/pandas versions, platform, current rustc/cargo versions, the rustc that built the cached binaries (target/.rustc_info.json), the full src/ tree hash per epoch, the compiled src files not covered by the 17-file identity hash, and a recomputed binary sha256. Done without recompiling.

provenance.statement: REI_COMMIT binds the composed RETURN.txt and history.csv by sha256 but holds no hash of this checkpoint. The checkpoint is linked through COMPOSITION_RECEIPT.json (sha256 recorded here) and bound by content: every RETURN counter/clock/error field and both residuals equal the checkpoint and the natively recomputed values. Not a git-anchored hash chain at REI_COMMIT; ref tips that do hold the checkpoint sha256 are in git_anchors.

review_corrections.change: Removed the per-case cosmic_age_at_mean_z20_s_from_locked_background and cosmic_age_at_restart_s fields and the a=1e-12..a_ref quadrature of the sheared H law that produced them (outside the locked domain; SCENARIO_LOCK clock.absolute_cosmic_age_s=null). Added one top-level q=0 FLRW age at zbar=20, labelled EXTERNAL_CONVENTION_OUTSIDE_LOCKED_DOMAIN and identical for all cases. No q-dependent extrapolated age is reported. The z<4 foreground H model is now labelled as an extension beyond a_end (sensitivity only).

Provenance is described as RECEIPT_LINKED_PLUS_CONTENT_BOUND for the four composed cases and GIT_MANIFEST_HASH_BOUND_PLUS_CONTENT_BOUND for SHEAR_PLUS. COMPOSITION_RECEIPT.json, composed RETURN.txt and composed checkpoint.txt are hashed into input_sha256. chain_ok now also requires equality of every RETURN counter/clock/error field with the checkpoint and of both RETURN residuals with the natively recomputed residuals. The git refs whose tips actually contain each checkpoint sha256 are found by a scan of the rei_bianchi object store run now, and the REI_COMMIT ancestry is recorded.

The dt-form versus dN-form agreement is reported as a clock/H consistency check (dt/dN=1/H) plus a quadrature-error estimate (native rows versus Richardson and versus a cubic spline). It is stated not to validate tau(4..20), because both forms share n_e, sigma_T and H.

Renamed ne_vs_native_eos_cm3, ne_vs_history_last_row_cm3 and abundance_rows_charge_neutrality_cm3 to electron_formula_*_consistency fields, and stated that charge neutrality is imposed by the EOS (n_e = n_H x_HII + n_He (x_HeII + 2 x_HeIII)); these are bookkeeping identities, not tests.

The z<4 list is now a top-level z_below_4_continuation with three independent blockers (1 scenario-lock scope, 2 DriverConfig::validate 4<=end_zbar<20, 3 source redshift guard plus no admitted z<4 source model), each with the source line found now in both compiled epochs, and with background domain, absolute age and stored H/s marked DERIVED or NON_BLOCKING. Each case records the positive control from the cached native replay: the config.cfg end_zbar passed DriverConfig::read and Driver::new (both call validate).

Each case states the replay window next to the residual: accepted-step count, zbar range, rejections in window, attempts per step and the per-step dln a regime (constant step, endpoint-clipped final step). The headline residual covers every compared field including ledgers, photons and the energy residual. The reject and step-size-change branches are listed as not exercised. No new native window run.

BUILD.json and the result record the script sha256, htt_base HEAD and dirty flag, script git tracking status, python/numpy/scipy/pandas versions, platform, current rustc/cargo versions, the rustc that built the cached binaries (target/.rustc_info.json), the full src/ tree hash per epoch, the compiled src files not covered by the 17-file identity hash, and a recomputed binary sha256. Done without recompiling.
